Having just watched some developer conference videos I want to make sure the dashboard is properly built - so I am repeating this question in the hopes it gets answered

My question is it proper to create the shiny app as a package?  I would like to write some methods (outside my main package) that support my shiny dashboard.  I have create a package with the traditional folder structure.  However, in the inst folder I have included /UI with ui.R and server.R file as shown below.  I am able able to the app as outlined below.  Now my app and all the functions etc. that support it are in the same package. Is this seem reasonable/okay  or am I begging for trouble down the road?

Glenn

Description
/inst 
   /UI 
     ui.R
     server.R
Namespace
/R


require(mypackage)
require(mypackageUI)
require(shiny)
require(shinydashboard)

   mypackageGUI <- system.file("UI", package = "mypackageUI")
   shiny::runApp(mypackageGUI)
